calls.video_title: Market Volatility Is Back — Here’s How to Profit in 15 Minutes
calls.thesis: Guest Kareem: buy Agnico Eagle — the premier gold miner in his view, better than Barrick and Newmont, with the best operations, operators and profit margins. Suggested for accumulating gold exposure / a covered-call play: miners have largely fixed costs, so margins expand exponentially as the gold price rises. No price stated. First tracked MarketBeat call on AEM.
